search.title: Patients
search.label: Find a patient
search.placeholder: Name, phone, national ID, file or MediLink number
search.noResults: No patient at this facility matches. Check the spelling, or search by phone or ID.
search.shortcuts: Press / to search and N for a new walk-in.

external.title: Already on MediLink
external.hint: This person is registered at another facility. Ask for their MediLink number to add them here.
external.proofHint: Confirm the MediLink number from the patient's card or phone.

register.title: Register a walk-in
register.nameHint: All names, as the patient says them.
register.phoneInvalid: Enter a Rwandan mobile number like 0788 123 456.
register.consentScript: Read aloud: "MediLink keeps your health records so the facilities you visit can care for you. Only staff caring for you can see them, and you can see who opened them."
register.consent: The patient agreed to care consent
register.possibleDuplicate: This patient may already be registered here.
register.confirmNotDuplicate: I checked the matches: this is a different person
register.suggestionsHint: Matches appear here once names and an age, or a phone number, are filled in.
register.elsewhere_one: {{count}} similar patient at another facility. Ask for an ID or MediLink number.
register.elsewhere_other: {{count}} similar patients at other facilities. Ask for an ID or MediLink number.
register.strongHint: Open the match to check before registering again.

record.openSurvivor: This record was merged. Open the remaining record.

reveal.description: The full value is recorded in the patient's access history with your reason.

insurance.rejectConsequences: The card will show as rejected until someone checks it again.

consents.scriptRead: I read the consent text and the patient agreed

claims.title: Record claim
claims.hint: The patient wants to link this record to their MediLink account. Check an identity document first.
claims.documentMatches: The identity document matches this record
claims.done: The record is now linked to the patient's account.

merges.conflicts: Different documents of the same kind: {{kinds}}. These records can't be merged.
merges.requestHint: Choose the other record of {{name}}. Another approver decides.

approve.title: Merge these records?
approve.consequences: Documents, insurance, health items and the file number move to the kept record. You can undo it later.

cancel.title: Cancel your request?
cancel.consequences: The request is closed without a decision.

escalate.title: Send to the platform team?
escalate.consequences: No one else here can approve it, so the platform team will decide.

undo.title: Undo this merge?
undo.consequences: Moved items go back to the original records, unless they changed since.
